mintAuthority.summary: frxUSD can be minted and redeemed through governance-approved FrxUSDCustodian contracts with per-custodian caps; the token and custodians are owned by the current 4/7 frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe, while proxy upgrades require the same Safe to pass through a 24-hour timelock.

controls.label: frxUSD-USDB Custodian Proxy
controls.capDescription: FrxUSDCustodian vaults mint/redeem frxUSD against approved backing assets subject to custodian-specific caps and fees.
controls.evidence: FraxNet docs list this custodian address; at Ethereum block 25546949 owner() returned the frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe, while EIP-1967 slots resolved implementation 0x1f6d8f7fbe237aee37fcf9df958bb8bb5948320e and ProxyAdmin 0x3cdf7631aa3c8015445041ff4c5b91783ad53c1d.

controls.label: frxUSD upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25546949, all six frxUSD token/custodian ProxyAdmins returned this verified Compound-style timelock as owner. Its admin() was the 4-of-7 frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe, pendingAdmin() was zero, and delay() was 86400 seconds; verified source requires the admin to queue upgrades and wait through the delay before execution.

controls.label: frxUSD owner/custodian admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25546949, frxUSD token owner(), every listed custodian owner(), and the upgrade timelock admin() returned this Safe. On-chain Safe reads returned version 1.3.0, threshold 4, the seven listed owners, no enabled modules, zero guard, and zero moduleGuard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25546949, the frxUSD token and all five custodian proxies published by Frax resolved distinct EIP-1967 implementations and ProxyAdmins. Every ProxyAdmin had identical verified runtime and owner() = 0xb898Ad2976b4d8f2E21521C9db16b7497825E503. That verified timelock had admin 0xfFFffF4F3baC444b2C0ecf2A1840d018bE783937, pendingAdmin zero, and a 86400-second delay. The same 4-of-7 Safe directly owned the token and every custodian, could raise their mint caps, and had no enabled modules, guard, or module guard. This establishes the complete published Ethereum token/custodian upgrade and mint-control chain; replacing mint-critical logic requires the Safe-controlled 24-hour timelock. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the Safe can raise custodian caps directly outside the upgrade timelock, while the live full-composition Frax/Chaos reserve feed provides continuous third-party reconciliation without named prudential supervision.
